svg.text: How long does a random walk spend on one side of zero?
20,000 simple random walks of 1,000 steps. Across: the fraction of the walk. Up: the share of walks in each bin of 0.05.
One walk of 1,000 steps: 12% on the positive side, highest at step 39, last at zero at step 116, longest stretch away from zero 884 steps
